candidates.title: Vaulted Symmetrical Entry Lane
candidates.usableFloorPolygonNotes: Deep central wood trapezoid to the front door; preserve side clearance from both sculptures.

candidates.title: Warm Oak One-Point Foyer
candidates.usableFloorPolygonNotes: Foreground-to-midground warm wood lane; terminate before the open door leaf, its swing zone, and the woven floor object.

candidates.title: White Arched Entry Gallery
candidates.usableFloorPolygonNotes: Clean long central lane; terminate before the shallow-focus distant door zone.

candidates.title: Bright Modern Entry Corridor
candidates.usableFloorPolygonNotes: Large central floor share; runner must stop before the far open-door swing.

candidates.title: Historic Stair-Side Passage
candidates.usableFloorPolygonNotes: Long stair-side lane; use a narrow runner with clearance from the newel and right wall.

candidates.title: Oblique Daylit Foyer
candidates.usableFloorPolygonNotes: Broad rectangle between bench and staircase; align the runner to floorboard and door perspective.

candidates.title: Glass Courtyard Concrete Gallery
candidates.usableFloorPolygonNotes: Very long polished-concrete lane beside glazing; placement must follow the off-axis vanishing direction.

candidates.title: Centered Herringbone Hall
candidates.usableFloorPolygonNotes: Long herringbone center polygon; stop before the furnished rear room.

candidates.title: Narrow Timber Vanishing Hall
candidates.usableFloorPolygonNotes: Clean narrow wood lane across nearly the full visible depth.

candidates.title: Warm Bedroom Passage
candidates.usableFloorPolygonNotes: Coherent warm wood corridor; runner ends before the bed and stool beyond the passage.

candidates.title: Rose and Charcoal Gallery
candidates.usableFloorPolygonNotes: Clear long wood polygon; leave a full exposed-floor gap before the terminal potted tree.

candidates.title: Attic Timber Corridor
candidates.usableFloorPolygonNotes: Long clear attic floor strip; stop before the coat at the endpoint.

candidates.title: Pale Herringbone Galley Hall
candidates.usableFloorPolygonNotes: Deep pale herringbone center lane; keep the runner clear of the mirror edge and stop before dining furniture.

candidates.title: White Paneled Herringbone Hall
candidates.usableFloorPolygonNotes: Uninterrupted center herringbone lane to the distant window; console and mirror remain outside the right edge.

candidates.title: Open Oak Landing Passage
candidates.usableFloorPolygonNotes: Broad oak circulation lane from foreground toward stairs; keep runner wholly on the single landing plane.

candidates.title: Arched Stone Gallery
candidates.usableFloorPolygonNotes: Deep centered cobble or stone lane through arches; rug must remain grounded over the uneven surface relief.

candidates.title: Sunlit Glazed Stone Gallery
candidates.usableFloorPolygonNotes: Broad middle-left stone lane; preserve hard window-shadow bands and keep clear of the right console.

conditionalRejects.rejectionReason: Source camera is eye-to-chest height and near-axial, while the landing is bounded by a balustrade/stair void on one side and a wall on the other. A real 60-75 degree midpoint camera position is not proven and must not be invented.
